title: ixeridium dentatum subsp. shiranense
intro: Ixeridium dentatum subsp. shiranense, commonly known as Japanese saxifrage, is a flowering plant species native to East Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, sore throat, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antipyretic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These bioactive compounds also contribute to its antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various diseases and conditions.
